infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: RoadWatch requires camera access to photograph road hazards and potholes.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: RoadWatch requires your GPS location to pinpoint and geotag potholes on the city map.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow RoadWatch to access your camera to capture pothole photos.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow RoadWatch to use your GPS location to geotag reported potholes.
